— 200 Returned if the scan report generation is complete.
— 202 Returned if scan report export request was accepted.
400 Returned if your request specifies an invalid scan UUID.
403
Returned if you do not have permissions for the scan. For more information, see Roles and
Permissions.
415 Returned if your request contains an invalid Content-Type  header.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
